constraints: Recompute the mandatory census and shape bounds.
Distinguish capability refusal from semantic mutation detection.
Do not require a toy non-enumerative compiler to beat B^5 enumeration.

completion_gate: No pending protocol field can hide source work, liveness, or tuple access.
The backend has an auditable exactness and overflow contract.
The live mutation schedule reaches every major claim surface.
Passing and failing interpretations remain finite and model-bound.
handoff.return_format: Use the repository handoff headings and end with one next concrete action.
